correctness.rationale: The determinant-one chain rule gives upper triangular coefficient matrix of homogeneous j-jets, whose absolute column sums P_{j,s}(q) strictly increase with j when q>0, so the top degree dominates. At L1 endpoint one cannot postulate independent jets, but the published Ornstein non-inequality for a chosen linearly independent homogeneous order-k operator against the remaining monomials yields smooth compactly supported almost single-column top jets. Reverse triangle inequalities plus high-frequency dilation eliminate cross terms and all lower orders, proving sharpness. Positive zeroth-order mass gives strict nonattainment for every nonzero input. Independent SymPy column-polynomial checks give order-2 cusp q=1 and order-3 upper envelope q=1/3 and 1+sqrt2. These finite algebra checks do not certify the analytic non-inequality, which was examined in the primary paper.
